regions.merged_text: God bless you and love Martha - you and yours. Hope this - enrollment - speed the hoped-for improvement in Sister Mary Thomas" health. Thank God it hardly ever faill. Fr. - Rt. Rev Mons. - E'd stopped off last Friday at Fort Wayne (25 miles N.E. ) and came down and I served his holy mass. He had been East since July. Thanks be to God he was quite successful in his mission efforts and looks well. I had word that Owen was to have an operation that day. We hope this finds him well back on his feet. How little we appre- ciate our incalculable privileges - blessings of our holy Faith. Glory be to God.
